## Steps

<Diagram id="step-flow" caption="A flow in three steps." build draw={(d) => {
  const a = d.box("Start")
  const b = d.box("Finish")
  d.row([a, b], { id: "both" })
  d.arrow(a, b, { id: "go", label: "go" })
  const hint = d.note("Only now", { id: "hint", stepOnly: true })
  d.place(hint, { below: a })
}}>
  <Step focus="start hint">Everything begins here.</Step>
  <Step id="end" focus="finish go">Then it moves on.</Step>
  <Step focus="both">Both ends, together.</Step>
</Diagram>
